title: Mysterious Cloaked Figure
description: A cloaked figure with a pale face floats above a circular pool of water with glowing patterns on its surface. The figure's hands reach down toward the pool while a giant gnarled tree with paint on its bark stretches across the starry sky with waterfalls flowing from its branches.
prompt: A cloaked figure with pale face floats above a circular pool of water that has glowing patterns on its surface. The figure reaches both hands down toward the pool. A giant gnarled leafless tree with paint on its bark stretches across the top of the image with waterfalls flowing from its branches. The night sky shows stars and green glowing lights. Small stone buildings and rocks sit around the edge of the pool.
